sub_answers.text: Results of each of the 12 shows were determined by a 50/50 combination of votes from a jury panel and public televoting.[d40165141s3p0] The jury votes in all shows consisted of a combination of a Lithuanian jury panel and an international jury panel.[d40165141s3p0] From the second show to the semi-final the Lithuanian panel came to a consensus to assign one set of points which were added to the international panel results, while international panel members assigned points individually in descending order for their preferences.[d40165141s3p0] In the final the Lithuanian and international panels voted together with each member awarding one set of points based on ranking.[d40165141s3p0] The public vote ranking was converted to points from 1–8, 10 and 12 and assigned based on the number of competing artists in the respective show.[d40165141s3p0]

sub_answers.sub_question: What tie-breaking procedures and qualification criteria were specified for advancing between heats, semifinals, and the final?
sub_answers.text: Ties in the elimination shows and the semi-final were decided in favour of the entry that received the most votes from the public.[d40165141s3p0] In the final, a tie was decided in favour of the entry that was awarded the most points by the jury.[d40165141s3p0] The competition structure specified eliminations by show: the second and third shows featured ten artists each with five eliminated from each show,[d40165141s3p0] during each of the fourth to tenth shows one artist was eliminated and the remaining three artists advanced from those shows,[d40165141s3p0] and the eleventh show (semi-final) selected the single winning song from the remaining three songs while the twelfth show (final) selected the winning artist–song combination from the remaining three artists.[d40165141s3p0]
